name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS) - with Maharashtra Shravan Bal top-up
benefit: Monthly pension for elderly persons from BPL households under the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP): central share of Rs 200 per month for ages 60-79 and Rs 500 per month for ages 80+. States add their own contribution - in Maharashtra, IGNOAPS beneficiaries also receive the state's Shravan Bal Seva Rajya Nivruttivetan Yojana top-up, taking the combined pension to about Rs 1,500 per month. Paid directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
eligibility_rules: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household as per the BPL list
Applicant must be 60 years of age or above
Applies in both rural and urban areas; beneficiaries are identified from BPL lists by Gram Panchayats (rural) and municipalities (urban)
For the Maharashtra Shravan Bal top-up, state rules on residence and income apply (destitute seniors 65+ are covered even without BPL listing under the state's own Shravan Bal Group A)
exclusions: Persons below 60 years of age are not eligible
Households not on the BPL list are not eligible for the central IGNOAPS pension
Applicants already receiving any other pension or financial assistance must declare it - an affidavit of not receiving other pension/assistance is required, and double-drawing is not permitted
documents_required: Residential proof (Voter card / electricity bill / Aadhaar card)
Age proof (birth certificate from school last attended, municipal authority, SHO, or medical board certificate)
Affidavit attested by Judicial/Executive Magistrate stating the applicant receives no other pension or financial assistance
how_to_apply: Online: via the UMANG app or web.umang.gov.in - log in with mobile OTP, search 'NSAP', click 'Apply Online', fill details, choose pension payment mode, upload photo and submit. Offline: apply through the Gram Panchayat / Talathi (rural) or municipal office (urban); in Maharashtra the Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch of the Tehsil office handles these pensions.
source_document: myScheme IGNOAPS page, NSAP Ministry of Rural Development; Maharashtra Shravan Bal Seva Rajya Nivruttivetan Yojana (state top-up)
